validation: Wine e158-byte00-var-0390-index-wine-s17tfsmr, e158-byte00-var-0330-callers-wine-yubooxtq, e158-byte00-var-0330-caller-wine-dce65adz and e158-byte00-var-0390-callee-wine-l4kbmaue bound the examined direct caller including the inherited register path.
